about.text: Internet Archive item (uploaded 2022-10-17) containing converted copies of Riot's legacy game patch systems ('laxorigin1' and RADS) re-packed into a modern chunked bundle format, with companion items for the original 2009-2011 laxorigin1 and 2010-2019 RADS data; item size about 266 GB; not a live tool.

coverage.text: RADS and laxorigin1 patch systems; description warns some assets were corrupted at source and integrity cannot be guaranteed
